description: Reference environment and downloaded inputs for the sps_resonances_paper pipeline. Stages 00 and 02 verify every fetch against the sha256 values recorded here.

python.provenance: version field of pyvenv.cfg in the reference virtualenv dev/mixing2006/.venv-sps-resonances-paper (untracked); that virtualenv was created from /usr/bin/python3.12 on the authoring machine

python_packages.provenance: exact versions of the distributions installed in the reference virtualenv dev/mixing2006/.venv-sps-resonances-paper, read from the *.dist-info metadata of its site-packages directory

editable_install.name: na49-mixing
editable_install.provenance: built from the dev/mixing2006 source tree itself, so its version follows the checkout and is not pinned here

not_installed.h5py: optional hdf5 extra declared in pyproject.toml (h5py>=3.8); not installed in the reference environment

sps_web.provenance: sha256 values computed on 2026-08-30 from the local SPS HADRONS mirror at the repository root (spshadrons.web.cern.ch/); the nested tree reaches the same files through the untracked symlink dev/mixing2006/spshadrons.web.cern.ch -> that mirror. The hashes identify the mirror contents, not a fresh verification against the live spshadrons.web.cern.ch server.

hepmc2_source_tarball.notes: Recorded 2026-08-31 from a verified download of the URL above (the tarball unpacks the HepMC-2.06.11 source tree). 02-build_external_generators/run.sh installs the archive only after this hash matches, and records a build-source receipt for the unpacked tree in reference mode.

urqmd_source_tarball.default_location: external/dist/urqmd-4.0.tar.gz (override with URQMD_TARBALL, or supply an unpacked tree with URQMD_SOURCE_DIR)
urqmd_source_tarball.notes: UrQMD is not redistributed by this repository and is never downloaded by the pipeline. The user supplies the tarball and records its sha256 here; 02-build_external_generators/run.sh verifies the tarball against this value whenever a 64-hex sha256 is recorded. An unpacked tree (URQMD_SOURCE_DIR or an existing external/urqmd-4.0) is accepted in reference mode only through a build-source receipt: stage 02 writes one when it extracts the verified tarball, and a user-supplied tree must be attested once with URQMD_ATTEST_TREE=1, which records the deterministic tree digest (tree_sha256 in common.sh). While this field holds the marker, reference mode (BOOTSTRAP_REPRO_LOCK not 1) treats the pin as unresolved: preflight records a FAIL, run_full.sh stops before stage 02, and stage 02 refuses the unverified tarball; BOOTSTRAP_REPRO_LOCK=1 keeps the bootstrap warning-and-continue behavior.

crmc.notes: Recorded 2026-08-31: the tag v1.7.0-alice1 is a lightweight tag that points directly at this commit (verified with git ls-remote plus an object-type check, so no tag-object peeling was needed). 02-build_external_generators/run.sh fetches exactly this commit and verifies git rev-parse HEAD against it; an existing checkout without .git metadata is refused in reference mode. CRMC_COMMIT overrides the recorded pin, explicitly breaks reproducibility, and is refused outside bootstrap mode (BOOTSTRAP_REPRO_LOCK=1).

generators.build_parallelism: cmake --build ... --parallel <MAKE_JOBS> and make -j<MAKE_JOBS> use the local CPU count; build parallelism is machine-dependent and deliberately not part of this manifest

source_repository.notes: Heads of the two source trees (monorepo root and dev/mixing2006) that this manifest was written against, refreshed at release time so they agree with the Repository state section of the matching archive's MANIFEST.txt. The release archives are working-tree snapshots, so the recorded heads identify the committed baseline of the archive; any uncommitted changes carried by a snapshot are listed in that archive's MANIFEST.txt.

random_seeds.provenance: defaults defined in sps_resonances_paper/common.sh; stage scripts and benchmark drivers derive their generator seeds from these bases

analysis.configuration_notes: sha256 values cover the committed configuration JSON files referenced from sps_resonances_paper/common.sh (copies under dev/mixing2006/helpers/benchmarking/config, the tree the paper pipeline runs in). Each benchmark run records its own configuration digests in the run's provenance output; the values here identify the reference configuration files this manifest was written against.
